description: A day's games in every league, grouped by league, with each moneyline's chance (Kalshi, percent): today (New York) or the date given; an empty day names next_date. A league and no date: its upcoming games, priced. No sign-in.

date.description: today (default; tonight is the same), tomorrow or YYYY-MM-DD.

league.description: nfl, ncaaf, mlb, nhl, nba, epl, ucl or all (default).

limit.description: A day: max 100. A league: default 20.

name: list_games
title: List games
